title: Pentagon UFO Files: Radar Caught Something That May Have Hit 1,650 MPH At Up To 70,000 Feet
description: The Department of War has released its eighth tranche of declassified UFO files, which includes videos and documents from the military and other sources, according to a Nov. 20 statement. One file details an unresolved detection event in the Western United States in 2023, in which a civil air-surveillance radar system recorded eight detections at an estimated altitude of 55,000-70,000 feet over 84 seconds, the department said. The data do not independently establish that all eight detections originated from the same object or from an unbroken path followed by an object. If these detections were all related to a single continuous track, it would suggest the object was moving at a minimum mean horizontal ground speed of about 1,650 miles per hour, the department said. Another file of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon submitted by the U.S. Central Command contains 20 seconds of infrared video in which an “area of contrast” moves from right to left across the frame, the department said. The video was taken in 2020 in the Middle East. Another video of an unresolved anomalous phenomenon was reported from the Middle East this year.
